answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in opal and thread lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the oasis graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1765 impostors cost 540 times the honest price and take 11 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
